source.title: This Venomous Abyss Curio Makes Picking Tier Pieces Way Easier

quote: Each tier piece from curios costs 1 curio
notes: NEW secondary numeric reference for the existing Tier 36 Curio 270909 (no original player cast/transaction observed). One curio exchanged at Kirana in Silvermoon for a chosen Tier 36 armor slot. Difficulty -> item level: Raid Finder hands/shoulders 282, head/chest/legs 285; Normal hands/shoulders 295, head/chest/legs 298; Heroic hands/shoulders 308, head/chest/legs 311; Mythic hands/shoulders 321, head/chest/legs 324. The Curio's own base item level 219 must not be mistaken for the selected reward's level. Independent raid tier slot corroboration: https://expcarry.com/venomous-abyss-tier-tokens-bosses-armor-slots (2026-08-15), https://www.wowhead.com/item=270909/slumbering-coil-curio; unverified exact vendor reward itemLink bonus IDs and live transaction. SOURCE CONFLICT: Method's 2026-08-10 guide states Heroic Sszorak legs 305, contrasting with Icy Veins 311 and the independent raid loot table for Sszorak; keep raw conflict and require current live itemLink before publishing bonus mapping. No expected processing units, drop probability, skill, casts or gold prices implied.
vendor: Kirana, Silvermoon City near the Catalyst
cost: 1 Slumbering Coil Curio per chosen tier piece
